title: SREV-111 driver public security and private handles

official_security_shape.description: Official ACL, security descriptor, and mandatory integrity control shape

private_handle_shape.description: Official private kernel handle and ObReferenceObjectByHandle shape

source_change.description: Checked security construction status and OBJ_KERNEL_HANDLE hardening

runtime_matrix.description: Windows driver-load, verifier, and low-integrity runtime proof

contracts: Driver_InitPublicSecurity builds absolute security descriptors owned by the driver
ACL and security descriptor construction DDIs return NTSTATUS and must fail closed
Driver_PublicAcl grants the existing compatibility DACL to Authenticated Users and Everyone
Driver_LowLabelSd keeps the Vista and later low-integrity SACL plus restricted-code DACL path
Mandatory Integrity Control stores an integrity label in an object's SACL through SYSTEM_MANDATORY_LABEL_ACE
Driver_FindHomePath creates only private driver handles for the registry key and installation directory
private registry and file handles are created with OBJ_KERNEL_HANDLE
ObReferenceObjectByHandle with KernelMode is used only on the kernel-private file handle
this SREV must not change SID values access masks descriptor consumers or public object policy
runtime proof is required for driver-load failure injection Driver Verifier and low-integrity consumers
